title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 319 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 319 - Punishment for Transfer of Property to Prevent Attachment If the owner of any property, or his agent or person claiming on his behalf, after receiving notice from the tax recovery officer, sells, mortgages, settles, leases or otherwise disposes of any property for the purpose of prevention of attachment, he shall be punished with imprisonment up to 5 (five) years or fine or both.
